mentions.name: Faraday
mentions.description: Faraday is a highly organised email client with an opinionated design. It features auto-organisation, beautiful sub-sections, genre-grouping, and thread resolution that removes nested blockquotes in email threads, plus additional intelligent conveniences.
mentions.problem: Started out of the author's own need to fix disorganised email, finding email outdated even after 40 years of its existence.
mentions.source_excerpt: A promptlessly intelligent, highly organised email client. Has very opinionated design with auto-organisation, beautiful sub-sections, genre-grouping, and thread resolution like never before in the history of email.

evidence.value: A promptlessly intelligent, highly organised email client. Has very opinionated design with auto-organisation, beautiful sub-sections, genre-grouping, and thread resolution like never before in the history of email.
